verdict.rationale: Typesense documents semantic/vector search, natural-language search, and a dedicated 'Typesense for AI Agents' guide, which can serve as the retrieval layer for RAG pipelines, but there is no documented conversational 'answer' API (e.g., built-in LLM-generated answers) — only retrieval primitives that developers must wire into their own RAG/answer logic. Missing for 10: a first-party answer-generation/conversational API, end-to-end RAG example wiring retrieval to an LLM, and independent confirmation of RAG use in production.
